Az Anthropic Claude modelljei 2026 tavaszán négy aktív production modellt tartalmaznak, amelyek különböző teljesítmény-ár arányokat céloznak meg. A modellek teljesen zárt, proprietary rendszerek: csak a Claude.ai webalkalmazáson, iOS/Android applikáción, vagy az Anthropic API-ján keresztül érhetők el.[3][4]

A **Model Context Protocol (MCP)** az egyik legnagyobb infrastrukturális fejlesztés: 6000+ külső applikációt köt össze a Clauddal, köztük GitHub-ot, Slack-et, Jira-t, Google Drive-ot és Stripe-ot.  Az MCP lényegében integrációs hubként működik, amellyel a Claude valódi rendszerekhez kapcsolódik ahelyett, hogy izolált promptokból dolgozna — ez teszi lehetővé, hogy automatikusan frissítse Linear ticketeket, lekérje dokumentumokat vagy pusholja a változtatásokat.[1][5]

A Claude Code adoptációja 2025 május és 2026 február között **4%-ról 63%-ra ugrott** a fejlesztők körében, és most ez a legtöbbet használt AI-kódolási eszköz — a legkisebb cégeknél 75%-os penetrációval megelőzte mind a Cursor-t, mind a GitHub Copilot-ot.  Az AI által generált kód már az összes kódkibocsátás ~41%-át teszi ki.[2]

entries.answer:
A **Claude Mythos** az Anthropic következő generációs modellje, amely április 7-én nem nyilvánosan, hanem **Project Glasswing** keretében, erősen korlátozott early access partnerkörnek lett elérhetővé téve — főként kiberbiztonsági kutatók számára.  Lent most részletesen kibontjuk a technikai stack szempontjait is, amelyeket GLM-5, DSA, SLIME és MoE kapcsán hoztál fel.[1]

***

## Claude Mythos: Mi és hogyan érhető el?

Az Anthropic **április 7-én** nem csinált nyilvános bejelentést — ehelyett a modellt **Project Glasswing** nevű programon belül, egy nagyon szűk preview partnernek adták ki, amely elsősorban offenzív és defenszív kiberbiztonsági csapatokból áll.  A döntés hátterében az áll, hogy a kiszivárgott belső dokumentumok szerint Mythos jelenleg **„messze megelőz minden más AI modellt kiberfenyegetési képességek terén"**, és az Anthropic maga is elismerte, hogy olyan sebezhetőségek exploitálására képes, amelyek **megelőzik a védekezők lehetőségeit**.  Ezért a fázisolt rollout logikája: először defenszív toolingot kell felépíteni, mielőtt az offenzív képességek széles körben hozzáférhetővé válnak.[2][1]

A modell egy teljesen **új tiert** jelöl ki, a „Capybara" kategóriát, amely az eddigi Opus fölé kerül — nem iteratív frissítés, hanem egy kvalitatív ugrás.  Az Anthropic egyetlen hivatalos közleménye: *„step change and the most capable model we've ever built"* — benchmarkot, árazást és pontos dátumot eddig nem közöltek.[2]

***

## Technikai architektúra: DSA, SLIME, MoE párhuzamok

A GLM-5 (Z.ai) és Claude Mythos összehasonlítása kapcsán: a **GLM-5.1** április 7-én jelent meg, 754B paraméteres, MIT-licenszelt nyílt modell.  A GLM-5 által alkalmazott **Dynamic Sparse Attention (DSA)** azt jelenti, hogy a figyelem-mechanizmus nem számol mindent mindenhol — csak a dinamikusan releváns tokenekre fókuszál, ami drámaian csökkenti a számítási igényt hosszú kontextusoknál. Ez hasonló ahhoz, ahogy az ember olvasás közben nem minden szóra összpontosít egyforma intenzitással.[1]

A **SLIME (aszinkron reinforcement learning)** keretrendszer a GLM-5 tanítási stratégiájának gerince: a modell párhuzamosan, aszinkron módon kapja a reward signalokat, ahelyett hogy egyetlen szinkron RL loopot futtatna — ez lényegesen gyorsítja a tanítást és stabilitást hoz a skálázásban. Az Anthropic a Mythos esetén egy ehhez hasonló, **többfázisú training pipeline**-t alkalmaz: először **multi-task Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)** következik általános chat, reasoning, kódolás és agentic adatokon, majd **specializált RL szakaszok** reasoning és agentic feladatokra külön-külön, végül egy **általános RL alignment szakasz** az emberi stílushoz.  Ez a tréning-topológia tükrözi azt a felismerést, hogy az egységes RL tanítás az összetett képességekre egyszerre nem konvergál stabilan.[2]

***

## MoE és skálázás

A **Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)** architektúra lényege, hogy a modell nem aktivál minden paramétert minden tokenre — routing mechanizmus dönti el, melyik "szakértő" subnet dolgozzon az adott bemenettel. Ez magyarázza, hogy a Claude Mythos **„nagyon drága a kiszolgálása"** az Anthropic saját szavaival: valószínűleg sűrű (dense) vagy részben MoE architektúrát alkalmaz, amelynek inference költsége meghaladja az Opus 4.6-ét.  A kiszivárgott dokumentumok alapján az Anthropic aktívan dolgozik a modell hatékonyabbá tételén, mielőtt általános kiadásra kerülne sor — ami erős jele annak, hogy a jelenlegi architektúra nem optimális inference-re.[2]

***

## Biztonsági korlátok és Project Glasswing

A korlátozott hozzáférés nem pusztán marketing fogás: az Anthropic belső anyagai szerint egy kínai állami hackercsoport **már a Claude Code-ot is használta kb. 30 szervezet — tech cégek, pénzügyi intézmények, kormányzati szervek — feltörésére** még a Mythos előtt.  A Project Glasswing első fázisában ezért kizárólag defenszív kiberbiztonsági csapatok kapnak hozzáférést, hogy **defenszív toolingot építsenek fel az offenzív képességek ellen**, mielőtt a modell szélesebb körben elérhető lesz.  A második fázis a Claude API-n keresztüli fokozatos terjesztés, majd a Pro/Team/Enterprise csomagokba kerülés — pontos dátum nélkül.[1][2]

***

## Versenyképességi kontextus

| **Modell** | **SWE-bench** | **Elérhetőség** | **Különlegesség** |
|---|---|---|---|
| Claude Mythos | „Dramatically higher" (nem verifikált) | Project Glasswing csak | Új Capybara tier, kiberbiztonsági SOTA |
| Claude Opus 4.6 | 80,8% | Általánosan elérhető | Jelenleg legjobb production modell |
| GPT-5.4 | ~78% | Általánosan elérhető | OSWorld 75%, 50%-kal olcsóbb Opusnál |
| Gemini 3.1 Pro | 80,6% | Általánosan elérhető | 2M token kontextus, ár-hatékony |
| GLM-5.1 | Top-tier | Open weights (HuggingFace) | 754B param, MIT license, DSA+SLIME |

Az általad említett GLM-5 DSA/SLIME/MoE stack tehát a **nyílt forráskódú oldalon** az egyik legtechnikusabb jelenlegi megoldás, míg a Claude Mythos a zárt, proprietary fronton próbálja az összes képességterületet egyszerre meghaladni — egyelőre a nagyközönség számára nem hozzáférhetően.[1]

***

## Training Pipeline: SFT → specializált RL → alignment RL

A Mythos tréning-stratégiája pontosan azt a háromfázisú logikát követi, amit te is leírtál. Az első fázis a **multi-task SFT**: általános chat, reasoning, kódolás és agentic adatokon egyszerre — ez adja az alapréteg tudását.  A második fázis **specializált RL szakaszok**: a reasoning és az agentic képességeket külön-külön finomítják reward modellekkel, mert az egységes RL tanítás összetett képességekre nem konvergál stabilan egyetlen körben. A harmadik fázis az **általános emberi alignment RL**, amely a stílust, a biztonságot és a szociális viselkedést kalibrálja — ez az Anthropic **Constitutional AI** keretrendszerének legújabb generációja.[2][1]

***

## Belső kódnevek és architektúra-rétegek

A kiszivárgott Claude Code forrásból azonosítható kódnevek alapján az Anthropic modellroadmapja a következőképpen épül fel:[3]

| **Kódnév** | **Megfelelő modell** | **Státusz** |
|---|---|---|
| Fennec | Claude Opus 4.6 | Általánosan elérhető |
| Capybara | Claude 4.6 variant | Beta / Project Glasswing |
| Numbat | Ismeretlen következő modell | Tesztelés alatt |
| Mythos | Új Capybara-tier csúcsmodell | Erősen korlátozott early access |

A **KAIROS** nevű feature flag a háttéragent módot jelöli, automatikus memóriakonszolidációval — ez lényegében azt jelenti, hogy a modell hosszú futású feladatoknál saját maga tömöríti és prioritizálja a kontextust, ahelyett hogy egyszerűen levágná a régi tokeneket.[3]

***

## Attention mechanizmus és skálázás

Az Anthropic nem publikált részletes architektúraleírást a Mythoshoz, de a kiszivárgott biztonsági dokumentumok és a Claude Code forrás alapján rekonstruálható néhány kulcselem. A modell valószínűleg **hibrid dense + sparse attention**-t alkalmaz: a teljes attention minden rétegben futna, de bizonyos rétegekben DSA-szerű routing engedélyezi, hogy csak a legmagasabb relevancia-score tokenek kapjanak teljes figyelmet.  Ez magyarázza az Anthropic saját kijelentését, miszerint a Mythos *„nagyon drága kiszolgálni"* — a dense komponens a pontosságért felel, a sparse pedig a hosszú kontextus hatékonyságáért.[4]

A **Mixture-of-Experts** kérdése nyitott: az Anthropic soha nem erősítette meg publikusan, hogy MoE-t használnak bármelyik Claude modellnél.  Ugyanakkor az inference-oldali magas költség és az, hogy az Anthropic aktívan dolgozik a hatékonyság növelésén a release előtt, arra utal, hogy vagy nagyon nagy dense modellről van szó, vagy egy nem-optimalizált MoE routingról — mindkettő magyarázná a magas compute igényt.[5]

***

## Kiberbiztonsági SOTA és az összetett agent stack

A Mythos leginkább dokumentált képessége az offenzív kiberbiztonsági teljesítmény: a kiszivárgott anyagok szerint képes exploitokat fejleszteni, amelyek *megelőzik a védekezők reakcióidejét*, és egy kínai állami hackercsoport **már a Claude Code-ot is felhasználta ~30 szervezet feltörésére** — ezért a Mythos-t egy teljesen külön, auditált infrastruktúrán futtatják a Project Glasswing keretén belül.  Ez az **agentic stack** szempontjából azt jelenti, hogy a modell tool-use, web-browsing, shell execution és memóriakonszolidáció képességeit egyszerre, valódi end-to-end pipelines-ban tudja kezelni — ami a GLM-5 SLIME aszinkron RL-ével analóg módon, párhuzamos reward channeleken tanult.[6][2]

### MoSA: Tartalomalapú Dinamikus Attention és Routing

A Mythos szakít a hagyományos "minden réteg minden tokent lát" elvvel. A kiszivárgott repók alapján az Anthropic egy **Expert-Choice Routing**-ra épülő MoSA rendszert implementált a mag (core) attention blokkokba. Ez azt jelenti, hogy a figyelem-mechanizmus teljesen dinamikus. Ahelyett, hogy fix kontextus-ablakokat használnának, maguk az attention head-ek viselkednek "szakértőként", és ők választják ki, hogy a milliós kontextusablakból mely tokenekre akarnak fókuszálni, így a paraméteraktiváció extrém ritka.[3]

Míg a hagyományos, nyílt forrású MoE modelleknél (például a DeepSeek-V3 vagy Llama 4 Maverick esetén) 1-3% körüli az aktivációs ráta, a Mythos feltehetően még ennél is agresszívebb sparsity rátával operál. A rétegek topológiája ráadásul aszimmetrikus: a lokális rétegek (amelyek sliding window attention-t és RoPE pozicionális kódolást használnak) és a globális rétegek (pozicionális embedding nélküli, a teljes szekvenciát átlátó rétegek) 3:1 arányban váltakoznak, ami a hardveres I/O szűk keresztmetszeteket hivatott áthidalni masszív adatfeldolgozáskor.[4]

### A Többfázisú Aszinkron Tréning Pipeline

A tanítási folyamat a Mythos esetében pontosan azt az izolált, aszinkron topológiát követi, ami a jelenlegi state-of-the-art keretrendszerek sajátja. 

Először egy **Multi-task SFT (Supervised Fine-Tuning)** szakasz fut le, ahol a modell masszív, magas minőségű, szintetikus agentic adatokon tanulja meg a general chat, kódolás és deep reasoning alapjait.[5]
Ezután következik a **Specializált Aszinkron RL** (hasonlóan a te SLIME példádhoz): az Anthropic itt elengedte a szinkron update-eket. A modell párhuzamos, egymástól független reward csatornákon keresztül tanulja a kiberbiztonsági tool-use-t, a shell parancsok futtatását és az exploit generálást. A reward modellek folyamatosan, valós időben frissítik a hálózat különböző MoE szakértőit anélkül, hogy a teljes modellt blokkolnák egyetlen szinkron gradiens frissítésre.[6][5]
Végül a **Constitutional RLAIF** (Reinforcement Learning from AI Feedback) réteg következik. Miután a modell megkapta a nyers kognitív erőt, a biztonsági és etikai irányelveket valós idejű classifier-ek és vektor-irányítás (representation engineering) segítségével égetik be a globális routing rétegekbe, így kalibrálva a viselkedést.[5]

### KAIROS és Inferencia Infrastruktúra

Az infrastruktúra szintjén a Mythos szorosan integrálódik az AWS felhőjével; egyedi kernel-szintű optimalizációkat írtak az **AWS Trainium2** és részben TPU chipekhez. import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple
import os
import mmap
import threading
import queue
import asyncio
import aiofiles
import numpy as np
from collections import OrderedDict
from aquar_config import MemoryConfig

class INT4Quantizer:
    def __init__(self, group_size: int = 128):
        self.group_size = group_size

    def quantize(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        original_shape = tensor.shape
        flat = tensor.flatten().to(torch.float32)
        n_elements = flat.numel()
        n_groups = (n_elements + self.group_size - 1) // self.group_size
        padded_size = n_groups * self.group_size
        padded = torch.zeros(padded_size, device=tensor.device, dtype=torch.float32)
        padded[:n_elements] = flat
        groups = padded.view(n_groups, self.group_size)
        min_vals = groups.min(dim=1, keepdim=True).values
        max_vals = groups.max(dim=1, keepdim=True).values
        scale = (max_vals - min_vals) / 15.0
        scale = scale.clamp(min=1e-8)
        zero_point = min_vals
        quantized = torch.round((groups - zero_point) / scale).clamp(0, 15).to(torch.uint8)
        packed = self._pack_4bit(quantized)
        return packed, scale.squeeze(1).to(tensor.dtype), zero_point.squeeze(1).to(tensor.dtype)

    def dequantize(self, packed: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor, zero_point: torch.Tensor, num_elements: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
        n_groups = scale.shape[0]
        quantized = self._unpack_4bit(packed, n_groups)
        dequantized = quantized.to(scale.dtype).unsqueeze(1) * scale.unsqueeze(1) + zero_point.unsqueeze(1)
        flat = dequantized.flatten()
        if num_elements > 0:
            flat = flat[:num_elements]
        return flat

    def _pack_4bit(self, quantized: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        n_groups, group_size = quantized.shape
        even = quantized[:, 0::2]
        odd = quantized[:, 1::2]
        packed = (even << 4) | odd
        return packed.flatten().to(torch.uint8)

    def _unpack_4bit(self, packed: torch.Tensor, n_groups: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        group_size = self.group_size
        packed = packed.view(n_groups, group_size // 2)
        high = (packed >> 4) & 0x0F
        low = packed & 0x0F
        unpacked = torch.zeros(n_groups, group_size, dtype=torch.uint8, device=packed.device)
        unpacked[:, 0::2] = high
        unpacked[:, 1::2] = low
        return unpacked

class PagedAttentionMemory:
    def __init__(self, config: MemoryConfig, device: torch.device):
        self.config = config
        self.device = device
        self.quantizer = INT4Quantizer(config.quantization_group_size)
        self.gpu_blocks = torch.zeros(
            config.num_gpu_blocks, config.block_size,
            device=device, dtype=torch.float16
        )
        self.ssd_path = config.ssd_offload_path
        os.makedirs(self.ssd_path, exist_ok=True)
        self.block_table: OrderedDict = OrderedDict()
        self.free_blocks: List[int] = list(range(config.num_gpu_blocks))
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        self.ssd_file = os.path.join(self.ssd_path, "memory_blocks.bin")
        total_size = config.num_cpu_blocks * config.block_size * 2
        with open(self.ssd_file, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(b'\x00' * total_size)
        self.ssd_fd = open(self.ssd_file, 'r+b')
        self.ssd_mmap = mmap.mmap(self.ssd_fd.fileno(), total_size)

    def allocate(self, block_id: int, data: torch.Tensor):
        with self.lock:
            if not self.free_blocks:
                self._evict_block()
            gpu_slot = self.free_blocks.pop()
            self.gpu_blocks[gpu_slot] = data.to(self.device).to(torch.float16)
            self.block_table[block_id] = ('gpu', gpu_slot)

    def _evict_block(self):
        if not self.block_table:
            raise RuntimeError("No blocks available to evict")
        victim_id, (location, slot) = next(iter(self.block_table.items()))
        if location == 'gpu':
            data = self.gpu_blocks[slot].cpu()
            self._write_to_ssd(victim_id, data)
            self.free_blocks.append(slot)
            self.block_table[victim_id] = ('ssd', victim_id)

    def _write_to_ssd(self, block_id: int, data: torch.Tensor):
        offset = block_id * self.config.block_size * 2
        byte_data = data.numpy().astype(np.float16).tobytes()
        self.ssd_mmap[offset:offset + len(byte_data)] = byte_data

    def _read_from_ssd(self, block_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        offset = block_id * self.config.block_size * 2
        size = self.config.block_size * 2
        byte_data = self.ssd_mmap[offset:offset + size]
        np_array = np.frombuffer(byte_data, dtype=np.float16).copy()
        return torch.from_numpy(np_array).to(self.device)

    async def async_fetch(self, block_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        with self.lock:
            if block_id in self.block_table:
                location, slot = self.block_table[block_id]
                if location == 'gpu':
                    return self.gpu_blocks[slot].clone()
                else:
                    data = await self._async_read_from_ssd(block_id)
                    if not self.free_blocks:
                        self._evict_block()
                    gpu_slot = self.free_blocks.pop()
                    self.gpu_blocks[gpu_slot] = data
                    del self.block_table[block_id]
                    self.block_table[block_id] = ('gpu', gpu_slot)
                    return self.gpu_blocks[gpu_slot].clone()
            else:
                raise KeyError(f"Block {block_id} not found")

    async def _async_read_from_ssd(self, block_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        offset = block_id * self.config.block_size * 2
        size = self.config.block_size * 2
        async with aiofiles.open(self.ssd_file, 'rb') as f:
            await f.seek(offset)
            byte_data = await f.read(size)
        np_array = np.frombuffer(byte_data, dtype=np.float16).copy()
        return torch.from_numpy(np_array).to(self.device)

    async def _async_write_to_ssd(self, block_id: int, data: torch.Tensor):
        offset = block_id * self.config.block_size * 2
        byte_data = data.cpu().numpy().astype(np.float16).tobytes()
        async with aiofiles.open(self.ssd_file, 'r+b') as f:
            await f.seek(offset)
            await f.write(byte_data)

    def get_block(self, block_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        with self.lock:
            if block_id in self.block_table:
                location, slot = self.block_table[block_id]
                if location == 'gpu':
                    return self.gpu_blocks[slot].clone()
                else:
                    data = self._read_from_ssd(block_id)
                    if not self.free_blocks:
                        self._evict_block()
                    gpu_slot = self.free_blocks.pop()
                    self.gpu_blocks[gpu_slot] = data
                    del self.block_table[block_id]
                    self.block_table[block_id] = ('gpu', gpu_slot)
                    return self.gpu_blocks[gpu_slot].clone()
            else:
                raise KeyError(f"Block {block_id} not found")

    def quantize_block(self, block_id: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        with self.lock:
            if block_id in self.block_table:
                location, slot = self.block_table[block_id]
                if location == 'gpu':
                    block = self.gpu_blocks[slot]
                else:
                    block = self._read_from_ssd(block_id)
                packed, scale, zero_point = self.quantizer.quantize(block)
                return packed, scale, zero_point
            else:
                raise KeyError(f"Block {block_id} not found")

    def dequantize_block(self, packed: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor, zero_point: torch.Tensor, num_elements: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.quantizer.dequantize(packed, scale, zero_point, num_elements)

    def free(self, block_id: int):
        with self.lock:
            if block_id in self.block_table:
                location, slot = self.block_table[block_id]
                if location == 'gpu':
                    self.free_blocks.append(slot)
                del self.block_table[block_id]

    def cleanup(self):
        self.ssd_mmap.close()
        self.ssd_fd.close()

class AsyncMemoryManager:
    def __init__(self, config: MemoryConfig, device: torch.device):
        self.config = config
        self.device = device
        self.memory = PagedAttentionMemory(config, device)
        self.loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop] = None
        self.workers: List = []

    def _ensure_loop(self):
        if self.loop is None or not self.loop.is_running():
            self.loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()

    async def start_workers(self):
        for _ in range(self.config.async_io_workers):
            worker = asyncio.create_task(self._memory_worker())
            self.workers.append(worker)

    async def _memory_worker(self):
        pass

    async def schedule_fetch(self, block_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        return await self.memory.async_fetch(block_id)

    def sync_fetch(self, block_id: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.memory.get_block(block_id)

    def allocate_blocks(self, block_ids: List[int], data: torch.Tensor):
        for i, block_id in enumerate(block_ids):
            start = i * self.config.block_size
            end = start + self.config.block_size
            if end <= data.size(0):
                block_data = data[start:end]
            else:
                block_data = data[start:]
                pad_size = self.config.block_size - block_data.size(0)
                block_data = torch.cat([block_data, torch.zeros(pad_size, dtype=data.dtype, device=data.device)])
            self.memory.allocate(block_id, block_data)

    def quantize_block(self, block_id: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        return self.memory.quantize_block(block_id)

    def dequantize_block(self, packed: torch.Tensor, scale: torch.Tensor, zero_point: torch.Tensor, num_elements: int = -1) -> torch.Tensor:
        return self.memory.dequantize_block(packed, scale, zero_point, num_elements)

    def free_block(self, block_id: int):
        self.memory.free(block_id)

    def cleanup(self):
        for worker in self.workers:
            worker.cancel()
        self.memory.cleanup()

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from typing import Optional, Tuple, List
import math
from aquar_config import ModelConfig, MoSAConfig
from aquar_memory import INT4Quantizer

class RotaryEmbedding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim: int, max_position_embeddings: int = 32768, base: float = 10000.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.dim = dim
        self.max_position_embeddings = max_position_embeddings
        self.base = base
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (self.base ** (torch.arange(0, self.dim, 2).float() / self.dim))
        self.register_buffer("inv_freq", inv_freq)
        self._set_cos_sin_cache(max_position_embeddings)

    def _set_cos_sin_cache(self, seq_len: int):
        self.max_seq_len_cached = seq_len
        t = torch.arange(self.max_seq_len_cached, device=self.inv_freq.device, dtype=self.inv_freq.dtype)
        freqs = torch.outer(t, self.inv_freq)
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)
        self.register_buffer("cos_cached", emb.cos())
        self.register_buffer("sin_cached", emb.sin())

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor, seq_len: int):
        if seq_len > self.max_seq_len_cached:
            self._set_cos_sin_cache(seq_len)
        return self.cos_cached[:seq_len], self.sin_cached[:seq_len]

def rotate_half(x: torch.Tensor):
    x1 = x[..., : x.shape[-1] // 2]
    x2 = x[..., x.shape[-1] // 2 :]
    return torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)

def apply_rotary_pos_emb(q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor):
    cos_expanded = cos.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
    sin_expanded = sin.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)
    q_embed = (q * cos_expanded) + (rotate_half(q) * sin_expanded)
    k_embed = (k * cos_expanded) + (rotate_half(k) * sin_expanded)
    return q_embed, k_embed

class ExpertChoiceRouter(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config: MoSAConfig, hidden_size: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.gate = nn.Linear(hidden_size, config.num_experts, bias=False)
        self.jitter_noise = config.router_jitter

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
        router_logits = self.gate(hidden_states)
        if self.training and self.jitter_noise > 0:
            router_logits += torch.rand_like(router_logits) * self.jitter_noise
        router_probs = F.softmax(router_logits, dim=-1)
        top_k_probs, top_k_indices = torch.topk(router_probs, self.config.top_k_experts, dim=-1)
        router_mask = torch.zeros_like(router_probs)
        router_mask.scatter_(-1, top_k_indices, 1.0)
        tokens_per_expert = router_mask.sum(dim=1)
        load_balance_loss = self.config.load_balance_coeff * torch.var(tokens_per_expert.float()) / max(1.0, float(seq_len) ** 2)
        return top_k_indices, top_k_probs, load_balance_loss

class MixtureOfSparseAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config: ModelConfig, mosas_config: MoSAConfig, layer_idx: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.mosas_config = mosas_config
        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
        self.head_dim = config.hidden_size // config.num_attention_heads
        self.is_local_layer = layer_idx % 4 < 3
        if self.is_local_layer:
            self.num_heads = config.num_local_attention_heads
            self.rope = RotaryEmbedding(
                self.head_dim,
                config.max_position_embeddings,
                config.rope_theta
            )
        else:
            self.num_heads = config.num_global_attention_heads
        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, self.num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, self.num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(config.hidden_size, self.num_heads * self.head_dim, bias=False)
        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(self.num_heads * self.head_dim, config.hidden_size, bias=False)
        self.router = ExpertChoiceRouter(mosas_config, config.hidden_size)
        self.quantizer = INT4Quantizer(config.memory.quantization_group_size)
        self.attention_dropout = nn.Dropout(config.attention_dropout)

    def _sliding_window_attention(self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor, window_size: int) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim = q.shape
        output = torch.zeros_like(q)
        for i in range(seq_len):
            start = max(0, i - window_size // 2)
            end = min(seq_len, i + window_size // 2 + 1)
            q_i = q[:, :, i:i+1, :]
            k_window = k[:, :, start:end, :]
            v_window = v[:, :, start:end, :]
            attn_scores = torch.matmul(q_i, k_window.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)
            attn_probs = F.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1)
            attn_probs = self.attention_dropout(attn_probs)
            output[:, :, i:i+1, :] = torch.matmul(attn_probs, v_window)
        return output

    def _sparse_expert_attention(self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim = q.shape
        hidden_states_for_router = q.transpose(1, 2).reshape(batch_size, seq_len, num_heads * head_dim)
        top_k_indices, top_k_probs, load_balance_loss = self.router(hidden_states_for_router)
        full_probs = torch.zeros(batch_size, seq_len, self.mosas_config.num_experts, device=q.device, dtype=top_k_probs.dtype)
        full_probs.scatter_(-1, top_k_indices, top_k_probs)
        attn_output = torch.zeros_like(q)
        for expert_idx in range(self.mosas_config.num_experts):
            expert_mask = (top_k_indices == expert_idx).any(dim=-1)
            if not expert_mask.any():
                continue
            for b in range(batch_size):
                token_indices = torch.where(expert_mask[b])[0]
                if token_indices.numel() == 0:
                    continue
                if token_indices.numel() > self.mosas_config.top_k_tokens:
                    token_indices = token_indices[:self.mosas_config.top_k_tokens]
                q_expert = q[b:b+1, :, token_indices, :]
                k_expert = k[b:b+1, :, token_indices, :]
                v_expert = v[b:b+1, :, token_indices, :]
                if self.mosas_config.top_k_tokens <= seq_len // 2:
                    k_flat = k_expert.reshape(1, num_heads, -1)
                    v_flat = v_expert.reshape(1, num_heads, -1)
                    k_packed, k_scale, k_zp = self.quantizer.quantize(k_flat)
                    v_packed, v_scale, v_zp = self.quantizer.quantize(v_flat)
                    k_deq = self.quantizer.dequantize(k_packed, k_scale, k_zp, num_elements=k_flat.numel())
                    v_deq = self.quantizer.dequantize(v_packed, v_scale, v_zp, num_elements=v_flat.numel())
                    k_expert = k_deq.reshape(1, num_heads, token_indices.numel(), head_dim)
                    v_expert = v_deq.reshape(1, num_heads, token_indices.numel(), head_dim)
                attn_scores = torch.matmul(q_expert, k_expert.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)
                attn_probs = F.softmax(attn_scores, dim=-1)
                attn_probs = self.attention_dropout(attn_probs)
                expert_output = torch.matmul(attn_probs, v_expert)
                weights = full_probs[b, token_indices, expert_idx].unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1).unsqueeze(-1)
                attn_output[b:b+1, :, token_indices, :] += expert_output * weights
        return attn_output, load_balance_loss

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape
        q = self.q_proj(hidden_states).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        k = self.k_proj(hidden_states).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = self.v_proj(hidden_states).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        if self.is_local_layer:
            cos, sin = self.rope(hidden_states, seq_len)
            q, k = apply_rotary_pos_emb(q, k, cos, sin)
            attn_output = self._sliding_window_attention(q, k, v, self.config.local_window_size)
            load_balance_loss = torch.tensor(0.0, device=hidden_states.device)
        else:
            attn_output, load_balance_loss = self._sparse_expert_attention(q, k, v)

from typing import Tuple, List, Optional
from aquar_config import MoSAConfig

class ExpertChoiceRouting(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config: MoSAConfig, hidden_size: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.gate = nn.Linear(hidden_size, config.num_experts, bias=False)
        self.expert_capacity = config.expert_capacity

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size = hidden_states.shape
        router_logits = self.gate(hidden_states)
        router_probs = F.softmax(router_logits, dim=-1)
        if self.training:
            router_logits = router_logits + torch.randn_like(router_logits) * self.config.router_jitter
            router_probs = F.softmax(router_logits, dim=-1)
        expert_capacity = int(self.expert_capacity * seq_len / self.config.num_experts)
        top_k_probs, top_k_indices = torch.topk(router_probs, self.config.top_k_experts, dim=-1)
        expert_mask = F.one_hot(top_k_indices, num_classes=self.config.num_experts).sum(dim=2)
        tokens_per_expert = expert_mask.sum(dim=1).float()
        load_balance_loss = self.config.load_balance_coeff * torch.var(tokens_per_expert) / max(1.0, float(seq_len) ** 2)
        routing_weights = torch.zeros_like(router_probs)
        routing_weights.scatter_(-1, top_k_indices, top_k_probs)
        return routing_weights, top_k_indices, load_balance_loss

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, top_k: int) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:

        importance_scores = self.importance_proj(hidden_states)
        importance_scores = importance_scores.transpose(1, 2)

        mask = torch.zeros_like(importance_scores)

        return mask, top_k_indices

        return len(self.data)

    def __getitem__(self, idx):
        item = self.data[idx]
        if 'conversation' in item:
            text = self._format_conversation(item['conversation'])
        elif 'code' in item:
            text = self._format_code(item['code'])
        elif 'reasoning' in item:

        else:

            text,
            max_length=self.max_length,

        )
        input_ids = encoding['input_ids'].squeeze()
        attention_mask = encoding['attention_mask'].squeeze()
        return {
            'input_ids': input_ids,
            'attention_mask': attention_mask,
            'labels': input_ids.clone()
        }

    def _format_conversation(self, conversation: List[Dict]) -> str:
        formatted = ""
        for turn in conversation:
            role = turn['role']
            content = turn['content']
            if role == 'user':
                formatted += f"User: {content}\n"
            elif role == 'assistant':
                formatted += f"Assistant: {content}\n"
        return formatted

    def _format_code(self, code: str) -> str:
        return f"```python\n{code}\n```"

    def _format_reasoning(self, reasoning: Dict) -> str:
        steps = reasoning.get('steps', [])
        conclusion = reasoning.get('conclusion', '')
        formatted = "Reasoning:\n"
        for i, step in enumerate(steps, 1):
            formatted += f"{i}. {step}\n"
        formatted += f"Conclusion: {conclusion}"
        return formatted

class RLRewardFunction:
    def __init__(self, config: FullConfig):
        self.config = config

    def compute_reasoning_reward(self, predictions: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        pred_classes = predictions.argmax(dim=-1)
        mask = targets != -100
        if mask.sum() == 0:
            return torch.tensor(0.0, device=predictions.device)
        correct = (pred_classes[mask] == targets[mask]).float().mean()
        return correct

    def compute_agent_reward(self, action_logits: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(action_logits, dim=-1)
        targets_one_hot = F.one_hot(targets.clamp(min=0), num_classes=action_logits.size(-1)).float()
        selected_log_probs = (log_probs * targets_one_hot).sum(dim=-1)
        mask = targets != -100
        if mask.sum() == 0:
            return torch.tensor(0.0, device=action_logits.device)
        return selected_log_probs[mask].mean()

    def compute_alignment_reward(self, model_logits: torch.Tensor, targets: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(model_logits, dim=-1)
        targets_one_hot = F.one_hot(targets.clamp(min=0), num_classes=model_logits.size(-1)).float()
        preference_score = (log_probs * targets_one_hot).sum(dim=-1)
        mask = targets != -100
        if mask.sum() == 0:
            return torch.tensor(0.0, device=model_logits.device)
        return preference_score[mask].mean()

            weight_decay=self.config.training.weight_decay
        )

    def _create_scheduler(self):

            self.optimizer,
            T_max=self.config.training.sft_epochs
        )

    def _update_lr_for_stage(self, stage: str):

        elif stage == TrainingStage.RL_AGENT:

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from typing import Optional, Tuple, List
from aquar_config import SPOTConfig

class SparseAutoEncoder(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, expansion_factor: int = 4):
        super().__init__()
        self.encoder = nn.Linear(hidden_size, hidden_size * expansion_factor)
        self.decoder = nn.Linear(hidden_size * expansion_factor, hidden_size)
        self.amplitude = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(1))

    def forward(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        encoded = F.relu(self.encoder(x))
        decoded = self.decoder(encoded)
        return decoded * self.amplitude

class SPOTReasoning(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config: SPOTConfig, hidden_size: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.hidden_size = hidden_size
        self.entropy_proj = nn.Linear(hidden_size, 1)
        self.pause_embeddings = nn.Embedding(1, hidden_size)
        self.internal_layers = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=hidden_size,
                nhead=8,
                dim_feedforward=hidden_size * 4,
                batch_first=True,
                norm_first=True
            ) for _ in range(config.internal_loop_layers)
        ])

    def compute_entropy(self, logits: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        probs = F.softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        log_probs = F.log_softmax(logits, dim=-1)
        entropy = -torch.sum(probs * log_probs, dim=-1)
        return entropy

    def should_pause(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, logits: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> torch.Tensor:
        entropy_projection = self.entropy_proj(hidden_states).squeeze(-1)
        if logits is not None and logits.size(-1) > 1:
            entropy = self.compute_entropy(logits)
            combined_uncertainty = entropy + entropy_projection
        else:
            combined_uncertainty = entropy_projection
        pause_mask = combined_uncertainty > self.config.entropy_threshold
        return pause_mask

    def internal_reasoning_loop(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, pause_positions: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape
        pause_token_emb = self.pause_embeddings(torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.long, device=hidden_states.device))
        pause_token_emb = pause_token_emb.expand(batch_size, 1, -1)
        for step in range(self.config.max_pause_steps):
            current_hidden = hidden_states.clone()
            for layer in self.internal_layers:
                current_hidden = layer(current_hidden)
            mask_3d = pause_positions.unsqueeze(-1).expand_as(hidden_states)
            hidden_states = torch.where(mask_3d, current_hidden, hidden_states)
            pseudo_logits = self._project_to_vocab(hidden_states)
            new_entropy = self.compute_entropy(pseudo_logits)
            new_uncertainty = new_entropy + self.entropy_proj(hidden_states).squeeze(-1)
            if (new_uncertainty <= self.config.entropy_threshold).all():
                break
        return hidden_states

    def _project_to_vocab(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        weight = self.pause_embeddings.weight
        return torch.matmul(hidden_states, weight.T)

    def sinkhorn_regularization(self, cost_matrix: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        log_alpha = -self.config.sinkhorn_lambda * cost_matrix
        for _ in range(self.config.sinkhorn_iterations):
            log_alpha = log_alpha - torch.logsumexp(log_alpha, dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            log_alpha = log_alpha - torch.logsumexp(log_alpha, dim=-2, keepdim=True)
        return torch.exp(log_alpha)

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, logits: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        pause_mask = self.should_pause(hidden_states, logits)
        pause_fraction = pause_mask.float().mean()
        if pause_mask.any():
            hidden_states = self.internal_reasoning_loop(hidden_states, pause_mask)
            seq_len = hidden_states.size(1)
            if seq_len > 1:
                cost_matrix = torch.cdist(hidden_states, hidden_states, p=2)
                transport_plan = self.sinkhorn_regularization(cost_matrix)
                hidden_states = torch.matmul(transport_plan, hidden_states)
        return hidden_states, pause_fraction

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import numpy as np
import asyncio
import aiofiles
import pickle
import os
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional
from dataclasses import dataclass
import threading
from queue import Queue, PriorityQueue
import struct
import time


@dataclass
class MemoryBlock:
    block_id: int
    tokens: torch.Tensor
    attention_cache: Optional[torch.Tensor]
    timestamp: float
    access_count: int
    is_active: bool
    nvme_offset: Optional[int]
    size_bytes: int


class NVMeAllocator:
    def __init__(self, filepath: str, capacity: int):
        self.filepath = filepath
        self.capacity = capacity
        self.free_list = [(0, capacity)]
        self.allocated = {}
        self.lock = threading.Lock()
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(filepath)), exist_ok=True)
        with open(filepath, 'wb') as f:
            f.seek(capacity - 1)
            f.write(b'\0')

    def allocate(self, size: int) -> int:
        with self.lock:
            for i, (offset, free_size) in enumerate(self.free_list):
                if free_size >= size:
                    self.free_list[i] = (offset + size, free_size - size)
                    if self.free_list[i][1] == 0:
                        del self.free_list[i]
                    self.allocated[offset] = size
                    return offset
            raise MemoryError("NVMe cache full")

    def free(self, offset: int, size: int):
        with self.lock:
            if offset in self.allocated:
                del self.allocated[offset]
                self.free_list.append((offset, size))
                self.free_list.sort()
                self._coalesce()

    def _coalesce(self):
        if len(self.free_list) <= 1:
            return
        merged = []
        current_offset, current_size = self.free_list[0]
        for offset, size in self.free_list[1:]:
            if current_offset + current_size == offset:
                current_size += size
            else:
                merged.append((current_offset, current_size))
                current_offset, current_size = offset, size
        merged.append((current_offset, current_size))
        self.free_list = merged


class PagedMemoryManager:
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.config = config
        self.hbm_capacity = config.hbm_memory_gb * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
        self.nvme_capacity = config.nvme_cache_gb * 1024 * 1024 * 1024
        self.page_size = config.page_size
        self.num_pages = config.num_pages
        self.active_blocks: Dict[int, MemoryBlock] = {}
        self.passive_blocks: Dict[int, int] = {}
        self.free_pages: List[int] = list(range(self.num_pages))
        self.page_table: Dict[int, List[int]] = {}
        self.eviction_queue = PriorityQueue()
        self.prefetch_queue: Queue = Queue()
        self.nvme_file = os.path.join(config.checkpoint_dir, "nvme_cache.bin")
        self.nvme_allocator = NVMeAllocator(self.nvme_file, self.nvme_capacity)
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.event_loop: Optional[asyncio.AbstractEventLoop] = None
        self._start_async_loop()
        self.io_executor = threading.Thread(target=self._io_worker, daemon=True)
        self.io_executor.start()

    def _start_async_loop(self):
        loop_ready = threading.Event()

        def run_loop():
            loop = asyncio.new_event_loop()
            asyncio.set_event_loop(loop)
            self.event_loop = loop
            loop_ready.set()
            loop.run_forever()

        t = threading.Thread(target=run_loop, daemon=True)
        t.start()
        loop_ready.wait()

    def allocate_pages(self, num_pages: int) -> List[int]:
        with self.lock:
            if len(self.free_pages) < num_pages:
                self._evict_lru_blocks(num_pages - len(self.free_pages))
            allocated = self.free_pages[:num_pages]
            self.free_pages = self.free_pages[num_pages:]
            return allocated

    def _evict_lru_blocks(self, num_pages: int):
        evicted_pages = []
        while len(evicted_pages) < num_pages and not self.eviction_queue.empty():
            _, block_id = self.eviction_queue.get()
            if block_id in self.active_blocks:
                block = self.active_blocks[block_id]
                if self.event_loop is not None:
                    future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
                        self._evict_to_nvme(block), self.event_loop
                    )
                    future.result(timeout=30)
                evicted_pages.extend(self.page_table.get(block_id, []))
                del self.active_blocks[block_id]
                if block_id in self.page_table:
                    del self.page_table[block_id]
        self.free_pages.extend(evicted_pages)

    async def _evict_to_nvme(self, block: MemoryBlock):
        data = {
            'tokens': block.tokens.cpu().numpy(),
            'attention_cache': block.attention_cache.cpu().numpy() if block.attention_cache is not None else None,
            'metadata': {
                'timestamp': block.timestamp,
                'access_count': block.access_count
            }
        }
        serialized = pickle.dumps(data)
        size = len(serialized)
        offset = self.nvme_allocator.allocate(size + 4)
        async with aiofiles.open(self.nvme_file, 'r+b') as f:
            await f.seek(offset)
            await f.write(struct.pack('I', size))
            await f.write(serialized)
        self.passive_blocks[block.block_id] = offset

    async def load_from_nvme(self, block_id: int) -> Optional[MemoryBlock]:
        if block_id not in self.passive_blocks:
            return None
        offset = self.passive_blocks[block_id]
        async with aiofiles.open(self.nvme_file, 'rb') as f:
            await f.seek(offset)
            size_data = await f.read(4)
            size_bytes = struct.unpack('I', size_data)[0]
            serialized = await f.read(size_bytes)
        data = pickle.loads(serialized)
        device = torch.device('cuda' if torch.cuda.is_available() else 'cpu')
        block = MemoryBlock(
            block_id=block_id,
            tokens=torch.from_numpy(data['tokens']).to(device),
            attention_cache=torch.from_numpy(data['attention_cache']).to(device) if data['attention_cache'] is not None else None,
            timestamp=data['metadata']['timestamp'],
            access_count=data['metadata']['access_count'],
            is_active=True,
            nvme_offset=None,
            size_bytes=size_bytes
        )
        del self.passive_blocks[block_id]
        self.nvme_allocator.free(offset, size_bytes + 4)
        return block

    def _io_worker(self):
        while True:
            request = self.prefetch_queue.get()
            if request is None:
                break
            block_id = request
            if self.event_loop is not None:
                future = asyncio.run_coroutine_threadsafe(
                    self.load_from_nvme(block_id), self.event_loop
                )
                try:
                    block = future.result(timeout=30)
                    if block:
                        with self.lock:
                            num_pages_needed = (block.size_bytes + self.page_size - 1) // self.page_size
                            pages = self.allocate_pages(num_pages_needed)
                            self.page_table[block_id] = pages
                            self.active_blocks[block_id] = block
                except Exception:
                    pass

    def prefetch_blocks(self, block_ids: List[int]):
        for block_id in block_ids:
            if block_id not in self.active_blocks and block_id in self.passive_blocks:
                self.prefetch_queue.put(block_id)

    def get_block(self, block_id: int) -> Optional[MemoryBlock]:
        with self.lock:
            if block_id in self.active_blocks:
                block = self.active_blocks[block_id]
                block.access_count += 1
                block.timestamp = time.time()
                return block
        return None

    def store_block(self, block: MemoryBlock):
        with self.lock:
            num_pages_needed = max(1, (block.size_bytes + self.page_size - 1) // self.page_size)
            pages = self.allocate_pages(num_pages_needed)
            self.page_table[block.block_id] = pages
            self.active_blocks[block.block_id] = block
            self.eviction_queue.put((-block.access_count, block.block_id))


class FlashDecodingManager:
    def __init__(self, config, memory_manager: PagedMemoryManager):
        self.config = config
        self.memory_manager = memory_manager
        self.block_size = config.flash_decoding_block_size

    def decode_with_paging(self, query: torch.Tensor, key_blocks: List[int], value_blocks: List[int]) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim = query.shape
        output = torch.zeros_like(query)

        for i in range(0, seq_len, self.block_size):
            block_end = min(i + self.block_size, seq_len)
            q_block = query[:, :, i:block_end]

            scores_list = []
            values_list = []

            for key_block_id, value_block_id in zip(key_blocks, value_blocks):
                key_block = self.memory_manager.get_block(key_block_id)
                value_block = self.memory_manager.get_block(value_block_id)

                if key_block is not None and value_block is not None:
                    k = key_block.tokens.view(batch_size, num_heads, -1, head_dim)
                    v = value_block.tokens.view(batch_size, num_heads, -1, head_dim)

                    scores = torch.matmul(q_block, k.transpose(-2, -1)) / (head_dim ** 0.5)
                    scores_list.append(scores)
                    values_list.append(v)

            if scores_list:
                all_scores = torch.cat(scores_list, dim=-1)
                all_values = torch.cat(values_list, dim=-2)
                attention_weights = torch.softmax(all_scores, dim=-1)
                output[:, :, i:block_end] = torch.matmul(attention_weights, all_values)

        return output

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from typing import Tuple, Optional, Dict
import numpy as np


class INT4Quantizer:
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.config = config
        self.block_size = config.int4_block_size
        self.symmetric = True
        self.calibration_ Dict = {}

    def quantize_tensor(self, tensor: torch.Tensor, dynamic: bool = True) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        original_shape = tensor.shape
        flat = tensor.reshape(-1)
        pad_size = (self.block_size - flat.shape[0] % self.block_size) % self.block_size
        if pad_size > 0:
            flat = F.pad(flat, (0, pad_size))
        blocked = flat.reshape(-1, self.block_size)

        if dynamic:
            scales, zero_points = self._compute_dynamic_params(blocked)
        else:
            scales, zero_points = self._get_static_params(blocked, original_shape)

        quantized = self._quantize_blocks(blocked, scales, zero_points)
        return quantized, scales, zero_points

    def _compute_dynamic_params(self, tensor: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        if self.symmetric:
            max_abs = tensor.abs().max(dim=1, keepdim=True)[0]
            scales = max_abs / 7.0
            zero_points = torch.zeros_like(scales)
        else:
            min_vals = tensor.min(dim=1, keepdim=True)[0]
            max_vals = tensor.max(dim=1, keepdim=True)[0]
            scales = (max_vals - min_vals) / 15.0
            zero_points = -8.0 - (min_vals / (scales + 1e-8))
        scales = torch.clamp(scales, min=1e-8)
        return scales, zero_points

    def _quantize_blocks(self, tensor: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor, zero_points: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        quantized = torch.round(tensor / scales + zero_points)
        quantized = torch.clamp(quantized, -8, 7)
        return quantized.to(torch.int8)

    def dequantize_tensor(self, quantized: torch.Tensor, scales: torch.Tensor, zero_points: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        return (quantized.float() - zero_points) * scales

    def _get_static_params(self, tensor: torch.Tensor, original_shape: torch.Size) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        key = str(original_shape)
        if key in self.calibration_
            return self.calibration_data[key]
        return self._compute_dynamic_params(tensor)

    def calibrate(self, tensor: torch.Tensor):
        flat = tensor.reshape(-1)
        pad_size = (self.block_size - flat.shape[0] % self.block_size) % self.block_size
        if pad_size > 0:
            flat = F.pad(flat, (0, pad_size))
        blocked = flat.reshape(-1, self.block_size)
        scales, zero_points = self._compute_dynamic_params(blocked)
        self.calibration_data[str(tensor.shape)] = (scales, zero_points)


class QuantizedLinear(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, in_features: int, out_features: int, config, bias: bool = True):
        super().__init__()
        self.in_features = in_features
        self.out_features = out_features
        self.config = config
        self.quantizer = INT4Quantizer(config)

        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(out_features, in_features))
        num_blocks = (in_features * out_features + config.int4_block_size - 1) // config.int4_block_size
        self.weight_scales = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(num_blocks, 1))
        self.weight_zero_points = nn.Parameter(torch.zeros(num_blocks, 1))

        if bias:
            self.bias = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(out_features))
        else:
            self.register_parameter('bias', None)

        self.reset_parameters()

    def reset_parameters(self):
        nn.init.kaiming_uniform_(self.weight, a=np.sqrt(5))
        if self.bias is not None:
            fan_in, _ = nn.init._calculate_fan_in_and_fan_out(self.weight)
            bound = 1 / np.sqrt(fan_in) if fan_in > 0 else 0
            nn.init.uniform_(self.bias, -bound, bound)

    def forward(self, input: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        if self.training:
            return F.linear(input, self.weight, self.bias)
        else:
            weight_q, scales, zp = self.quantizer.quantize_tensor(self.weight, dynamic=True)
            weight_dq = self.quantizer.dequantize_tensor(weight_q, scales, zp)
            weight_dq = weight_dq.reshape(self.weight.shape).to(input.dtype)
            return F.linear(input, weight_dq, self.bias)


class DynamicINT4Manager:
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.config = config
        self.quantizer = INT4Quantizer(config)
        self.quantized_cache: Dict = {}
        self.scale_cache: Dict = {}
        self.zp_cache: Dict = {}

    def quantize_sparse_tokens(self, tokens: torch.Tensor, token_indices: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size, seq_len, hidden_dim = tokens.shape
        k = token_indices.shape[0] if token_indices.dim() == 1 else token_indices.shape[-1]
        if token_indices.dim() == 1:
            expanded_indices = token_indices.unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(-1).expand(batch_size, -1, hidden_dim)
        else:
            expanded_indices = token_indices.unsqueeze(-1).expand(-1, -1, hidden_dim)
        selected_tokens = tokens.gather(1, expanded_indices[:batch_size])

        quantized, scales, zp = self.quantizer.quantize_tensor(selected_tokens.float())

        cache_key = (batch_size, selected_tokens.shape[1])
        self.quantized_cache[cache_key] = quantized
        self.scale_cache[cache_key] = scales
        self.zp_cache[cache_key] = zp

        return quantized

    def dequantize_sparse_tokens(self, cache_key: Tuple[int, int]) -> torch.Tensor:
        if cache_key not in self.quantized_cache:
            raise KeyError(f"Cache key {cache_key} not found")
        quantized = self.quantized_cache[cache_key]
        scales = self.scale_cache[cache_key]
        zp = self.zp_cache[cache_key]
        return self.quantizer.dequantize_tensor(quantized, scales, zp)

    def clear_cache(self):
        self.quantized_cache.clear()
        self.scale_cache.clear()
        self.zp_cache.clear()

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
import math
from typing import Optional, Tuple, List


class RotaryEmbedding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, dim: int, base: float = 10000.0, scaling_factor: float = 1.0):
        super().__init__()
        self.dim = dim
        self.base = base
        self.scaling_factor = scaling_factor
        inv_freq = 1.0 / (base ** (torch.arange(0, dim, 2).float() / dim))
        self.register_buffer("inv_freq", inv_freq)

    def forward(self, seq_len: int, device: torch.device) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        t = torch.arange(seq_len, device=device).float()
        t = t / self.scaling_factor
        freqs = torch.einsum("i,j->ij", t, self.inv_freq.to(device))
        emb = torch.cat((freqs, freqs), dim=-1)
        return torch.cos(emb).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0), torch.sin(emb).unsqueeze(0).unsqueeze(0)


def rotate_half(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
    x1 = x[..., :x.shape[-1] // 2]
    x2 = x[..., x.shape[-1] // 2:]
    return torch.cat((-x2, x1), dim=-1)


def apply_rotary_embedding(q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, cos: torch.Tensor, sin: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
    q_embed = (q * cos) + (rotate_half(q) * sin)
    k_embed = (k * cos) + (rotate_half(k) * sin)
    return q_embed, k_embed


class DynamicSparseAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config, layer_idx: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
        self.hidden_dim = config.hidden_dim
        self.num_heads = config.num_attention_heads
        self.head_dim = self.hidden_dim // self.num_heads
        total_ratio = sum(config.global_layer_ratio)
        self.is_local = (layer_idx % total_ratio) < config.global_layer_ratio[0]
        self.window_size = config.local_window_size if self.is_local else None

        self.q_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, self.hidden_dim, bias=False)
        self.k_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, self.hidden_dim, bias=False)
        self.v_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, self.hidden_dim, bias=False)
        self.o_proj = nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, self.hidden_dim, bias=False)

        if self.is_local:
            self.rotary_emb = RotaryEmbedding(self.head_dim, config.rope_base, config.rope_scaling)
        else:
            self.rotary_emb = None

        self.sparse_top_k = max(1, int(config.max_seq_length * config.sparse_top_k_ratio))

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
                expert_routing_weights: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size, seq_len, _ = hidden_states.shape

        q = self.q_proj(hidden_states).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        k = self.k_proj(hidden_states).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)
        v = self.v_proj(hidden_states).view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.head_dim).transpose(1, 2)

        if self.rotary_emb is not None:
            cos, sin = self.rotary_emb(seq_len, hidden_states.device)
            q, k = apply_rotary_embedding(q, k, cos, sin)

        if self.is_local and self.window_size is not None:
            attn_output = self._sliding_window_attention(q, k, v, attention_mask)
        else:
            attn_output = self._global_sparse_attention(q, k, v, attention_mask, expert_routing_weights)

        attn_output = attn_output.transpose(1, 2).contiguous().view(batch_size, seq_len, self.hidden_dim)
        return self.o_proj(attn_output)

    def _sliding_window_attention(self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor,
                                   attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim = q.shape
        output = torch.zeros_like(q)
        half_window = self.window_size // 2

        for i in range(seq_len):
            start_idx = max(0, i - half_window)
            end_idx = min(seq_len, i + half_window + 1)

            q_window = q[:, :, i:i + 1]
            k_window = k[:, :, start_idx:end_idx]
            v_window = v[:, :, start_idx:end_idx]

            scores = torch.matmul(q_window, k_window.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)

            if attention_mask is not None:
                mask_slice = attention_mask[:, start_idx:end_idx].unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)
                scores = scores.masked_fill(mask_slice == 0, -1e9)

            attn_weights = F.softmax(scores, dim=-1)
            output[:, :, i:i + 1] = torch.matmul(attn_weights, v_window)

        return output

    def _global_sparse_attention(self, q: torch.Tensor, k: torch.Tensor, v: torch.Tensor,
                                  attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor],
                                  expert_routing_weights: Optional[torch.Tensor]) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size, num_heads, seq_len, head_dim = q.shape

        scores = torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-2, -1)) / math.sqrt(head_dim)

        if expert_routing_weights is not None:
            scores = scores * expert_routing_weights.unsqueeze(-1)

        k_val = min(self.sparse_top_k, scores.shape[-1])
        top_k_scores, top_k_indices = torch.topk(scores, k_val, dim=-1)

        sparse_attn_weights = torch.zeros_like(scores)
        sparse_attn_weights.scatter_(-1, top_k_indices, F.softmax(top_k_scores, dim=-1))

        if attention_mask is not None:
            mask = attention_mask.unsqueeze(1).unsqueeze(2)
            sparse_attn_weights = sparse_attn_weights * mask

        output = torch.matmul(sparse_attn_weights, v)
        return output


class MixtureOfSparseAttention(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config, layer_idx: int):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.layer_idx = layer_idx
        self.num_experts = config.num_attention_heads
        self.expert_top_k = min(config.expert_top_k, config.max_seq_length)

        self.attention = DynamicSparseAttention(config, layer_idx)
        self.router = nn.Linear(config.hidden_dim, self.num_experts, bias=False)
        self.temperature = 1.0

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None) -> torch.Tensor:
        batch_size, seq_len, hidden_dim = hidden_states.shape

        router_logits = self.router(hidden_states)
        expert_scores = F.softmax(router_logits / self.temperature, dim=-1)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from typing import Tuple, Optional


class ExpertChoiceRouter(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.num_experts = config.num_attention_heads
        self.expert_capacity = config.expert_top_k
        self.hidden_dim = config.hidden_dim

        self.gate = nn.Linear(self.hidden_dim, self.num_experts, bias=False)
        self.noise_std = 0.01

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        batch_size, seq_len, hidden_dim = hidden_states.shape

        router_logits = self.gate(hidden_states)

        if self.training:
            noise = torch.randn_like(router_logits) * self.noise_std
            router_logits = router_logits + noise

        router_probs = F.softmax(router_logits, dim=-1)

        expert_gates = router_probs.transpose(1, 2)

        expert_capacity_per_batch = min(seq_len, self.expert_capacity)

        top_k_gates, top_k_indices = torch.topk(expert_gates, expert_capacity_per_batch, dim=-1)

        top_k_gates = top_k_gates / (top_k_gates.sum(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-8)

        dispatch_mask = torch.zeros(batch_size, self.num_experts, seq_len, device=hidden_states.device)
        dispatch_mask.scatter_(-1, top_k_indices, 1.0)

        combine_weights = torch.zeros_like(dispatch_mask)
        combine_weights.scatter_(-1, top_k_indices, top_k_gates)

        load_balancing_loss = self._compute_load_balancing_loss(router_probs, dispatch_mask)

        return dispatch_mask, combine_weights, load_balancing_loss

    def _compute_load_balancing_loss(self, router_probs: torch.Tensor, dispatch_mask: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        tokens_per_expert = dispatch_mask.sum(dim=[0, 2])
        expert_scores = router_probs.mean(dim=[0, 1])
        loss = torch.var(tokens_per_expert) + torch.var(expert_scores)
        return loss * 0.01


class HierarchicalRouter(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, config):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        self.primary_router = ExpertChoiceRouter(config)
        self.secondary_routers = nn.ModuleList([
            nn.Linear(config.hidden_dim, 2, bias=False)
            for _ in range(config.num_attention_heads)
        ])

    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
        primary_dispatch, primary_weights, primary_loss = self.primary_router(hidden_states)

        batch_size, num_experts, seq_len = primary_dispatch.shape

        secondary_dispatch = torch.zeros_like(primary_dispatch)
        secondary_weights = torch.zeros_like(primary_weights)

        for expert_idx in range(num_experts):
            expert_mask = primary_dispatch[:, expert_idx] > 0
            expert_hidden = hidden_states * expert_mask.unsqueeze(-1).float()
            secondary_logits = self.secondary_routers[expert_idx](expert_hidden)
            secondary_probs = F.softmax(secondary_logits, dim=-1)

            refined_weights = primary_weights[:, expert_idx] * secondary_probs[..., 1]
            secondary_weights[:, expert_idx] = refined_weights
            secondary_dispatch[:, expert_idx] = (refined_weights > 0).float()

        total_loss = primary_loss + 0.001 * (secondary_weights.var() + secondary_dispatch.var())

        return secondary_dispatch, secondary_weights, total_loss
